about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká společnost, specializující se na výrobu grafických procesorů pro herní i profesionální trh a systémů na chipu pro mobilní zařízení a automobilový trh.

about.label: Apple Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma se sídlem ve městě Cupertino v Kalifornii. Firma byla založena v roce 1976, specializuje se na hardware a software.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká akciová nadnárodní společnost se sídlem v Redmondu ve státě Washington. Zabývá se vývojem, výrobou, licencováním a podporou široké škály produktů a služeb, které jsou spjaté především s počítači.

about.label: Micron Technology
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives.
about.summary_cs: Americká společnost vyrábějící polovodiče se zaměřením na počítačovou paměť a elektronickou paměť.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Internetový obchod patřící americké společnosti Amazon.com, Inc. se sídlem v Seattle ve státě Washington.

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americký nadnárodní technologický konglomerát se sídlem v Menlo Parku v Kalifornii. Společnost vlastní a provozuje mimo jiné Facebook, Instagram, Threads a WhatsApp.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americký celosvětově působící konglomerát, vytvořený 2.

about.label: Tesla
about.summary: American multinational automotive and clean energy company. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, it designs, manufactures, and sells battery electric vehicles, stationary battery energy storage devices from home to grid-scale, solar panels and solar shingles, and related products and services.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma sídlící v Austinu v Texasu. Tesla navrhuje, vyrábí a prodává elektromobily, tahače, úložiště elektrické energie a solární střešní tašky.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americký celosvětově působící konglomerát, vytvořený 2.

about.label: Intel
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units and related products for business and consumer markets.
about.summary_cs: Největším světovým výrobcem polovodičových obvodů a dalších zařízení.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.

about.label: Palantir Technologies
about.summary: American publicly traded company that develops data integration and analytics software.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová a technologická společnost se sídlem v Denveru, Colorado, specializující se na platformy pro integraci dat, analýzu a umělou inteligenci. Společnost má čtyři hlavní systémy: Gotham, Foundry, Apollo a AIP. about.label: Cisco
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. about.summary_cs: Jedna z největších počítačových firem dnešní doby a dominující hráč na poli síťových prvků. Mimo jiné vyrábí ethernetové i ATM switche, routery, VoIP gatewaye a IP telefony.

about.label: Lam Research
about.summary: American supplier of wafer-fabrication equipment and related services to the semiconductor industry.

about.label: Applied Materials
about.summary: American corporation that supplies equipment, services and software for the manufacture of semiconductor chips for electronics, flat panel displays for computers, smartphones, televisions, and solar products.

about.label: Costco
about.summary: American multinational corporation that operates a chain of membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores.
about.summary_cs: Největší členský velkoobchodní řetězec ve Spojených státech amerických, který je založen na systému cash and carry.

about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.

about.label: Netflix, Inc.
about.summary: American media company founded on August 29, 1997, by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in Scotts Valley, California, and currently based in Los Gatos, California, with production offices and stages at the Los Angeles–based Hollywood studios and the Albuquerque Studios.

about.label: CrowdStrike
about.summary: American cybersecurity technology company based in Austin, Texas. It provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services.

about.label: KLA Corporation
about.summary: American company based in Milpitas, California that makes wafer fab equipment.

about.label: Texas Instruments
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The company's focus is on developing analog chips and embedded processors, which account for more than 80% of its revenue.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, zabývající se výrobou integrovaných obvodů a počítačové techniky.

about.label: Marvell Technology
about.summary: American company, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, which develops and produces semiconductors and related technology.

about.label: Amgen
about.summary: American multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California. about.summary: American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. about.label: Gilead Sciences
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, that focuses on researching and developing antiviral drugs used in the treatment of HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, influenza, and COVID-19. It also develops medicines in therapeutic areas such as oncology and inflammation and cell therapy.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická společnost, zaměřující  se zejména na vývoj antivirotik.

about.label: Shopify
about.summary: Canadian multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, that operates a cloud e-commerce management platform for retail point-of-sale systems. Major customers include Tesla, LVMH, Nestlé, PepsiCo, AB InBev, Kraft Heinz, Lindt, Whole Foods Market, Red Bull, and Hyatt.

about.label: T-Mobile US
about.summary: American wireless network operator headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.

about.label: PepsiCo

about.summary_cs: Nadnárodní společnost, která se zabývá výrobou a prodejem nápojů a potravin.

about.label: ASML Holding
about.summary: Dutch company that develops and manufactures photolithography machines used to produce integrated circuits.
about.summary_cs: Nadnárodní firma nizozemského původu sídlící ve Veldhovenu. Specializuje se na vývoj a výrobu fotolitografických strojů, které se používají k výrobě integrovaných obvodů.

about.label: Western Digital
about.summary: American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, the company is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives.

about.summary: American biotechnology company that develops, manufactures, and markets robotic products designed to improve clinical outcomes of patients through minimally invasive surgery, most notably with the da Vinci Surgical System.

about.label: Fortinet
about.summary: American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products including firewalls, endpoint security and intrusion detection systems.

about.label: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was one of the first biotech firms to use an explicit strategy of rational drug design rather than combinatorial chemistry.

about.label: Arm Holdings
about.summary: British semiconductor and software design company headquartered in Cambridge, England, whose primary business is the design of central processing unit cores that implement the ARM architecture family of instruction sets.
about.summary_cs: Britská firma působící v oboru výpočetní techniky. Zabývá se vývojem procesorů ARM, ale také navrhuje a licencuje i celé počítačové platformy a vyvíjí programátorské nástroje.

about.label: Automatic Data Processing

about.label: Cadence Design Systems

about.label: Adobe
about.summary: American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Softwarová firma zaměřená na oblast počítačové grafiky, publikování a digitálního marketingu.

about.label: Datadog
about.summary: American company that provides an observability service for cloud-scale applications, providing monitoring of servers, databases, tools, and services, through a SaaS-based data analytics platform.
